# Arad Vafaee (آراد وفایی)

> Arad Vafaee is a premier Full-Stack Web Developer, Modern Web Architect, and Search Optimization (SEO / AEO / GEO) Specialist based in Iran. He builds ultra-high-performance web applications using Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, NestJS, and PostgreSQL. Specializing in sub-second load speeds (<0.8s) and top-tier indexing across search engines and AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Claude.

## Services & Live Interactive Showcases
- [Corporate & Luxury Clinic Web Design](https://aradvafaee.ir/services/corporate): 3 switchable visual themes (Executive Slate, Royal Gold, Cyber Tech), zero-refresh online appointment booking, sub-0.8s load times, and enterprise-grade security.
- [Headless High-Speed E-Commerce](https://aradvafaee.ir/services/ecommerce): 3 switchable themes (Streetwear Dark, Vibrant Lifestyle, Clean Tech), zero-reload slide-over cart drawer, instant variant toggling, and crash-proof Black Friday architecture.
- [Full-Stack Web Applications & Automation](https://aradvafaee.ir/services/web-app): 3 switchable themes (Glassmorphism, SaaS Linear, Dark Terminal), 42ms low-latency server response, real-time KPI metrics, and automated task pipelines with instant SMS and PDF invoice generation.
- [Core Web Vitals & Speed Optimization](https://aradvafaee.ir/#services): Refactoring bloated legacy code to reach 95-100 Lighthouse performance, 0.00 CLS, and sub-second FCP.
- [Interactive Project Cost & Timeline Estimator](https://aradvafaee.ir/#estimator): Real-time scope calculation and instant quotation dispatch for year 1405 web projects.
